observation.command:
CADDY_IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' qonnectra_caddy_dev)
echo "=== token endpoint discovery ==="
docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk --resolve api.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP https://api.localhost/api/v1/ | tr ',' '\n' | grep -i "auth\|token\|login" | head
echo "=== login ==="
docker run --rm --network qonnectra_network_dev curlimages/curl:latest -sk -X POST --resolve api.localhost:443:$CADDY_IP \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-CSRFToken: x" -H "Referer: https://api.localhost/" \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"AdminLocalPassw0rd!"}' \
  https://api.localhost/api/v1/auth/login/ -w "\nHTTP=%{http_code}\n" | tail -5
